abilities.effect: The mannequins all lurch towards the triggering creature, Striding up to 50 feet, then roll initiative.
abilities.name: Awaken
abilities.trigger: A creature comes within 30 feet of a mannequin

hazard.description: A host of violent spirits possess three clockwork mannequins, and each lashes out at any creatures that dare walk near.
hazard.disable: DC 37 Thievery (master) to jam a mannequin's clockwork mechanisms or Religion DC 35 (expert) twice to exorcise a spirit from a mannequin.
hazard.name: Malevolent Mannequins
hazard.reset: The haunt deactivates after it has no target creatures and resets, usually over the course of 1 round, as the mannequins move to their original positions. If a mannequin is more than 150 feet from its original position, the haunt takes longer to reset, as the mannequin moves back 150 feet each round.
hazard.routine: (9 actions) Each of the mannequins uses three of the haunt's actions on each turn, and the haunt loses three actions each turn for every disabled or destroyed mannequin. Each mannequin uses its first action to Stride up to 50 feet and its remaining two actions to make clockwork fist Strikes. Each has its own separate multiple attack penalty.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Clockwork
traits.text: Clockworks are intricate, complex constructs that can be programmed to perform specific functions. A clockwork creature must be wound regularly to function.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.
